1 κυριεύσας cod. Sequentia quoque mendosa sunt. 3-4 χιλιάδαν cod. ὀλι-
γοχρόνιοι pro ὀλιγοχρονιώτεροι scripsit semper epitomator. 6 ἔλαττον cod.
8-9 τῆς ἐνεργείας coni. Kroll. 11 μεσετάτην. 19-20 καὶ - ἢ ςʹ deest in altera
recensione. “Mercurius in singulis signis versatur dies XXVIII, Sol XXX, et par-
tem quandam reliquorum anni dierum quinque vel sex (scilicet 12 × 30 = 360
+ 5 vel 6 = 365 vel 366). „ Boll. 20 τῶν corr. Boll. : τῆς cod. 29 αὐξάνουσα cod.

sections.en:
1 κυριεύσας ('having ruled') the codex has. The following things are also faulty. 3-4 χιλιάδαν ('thousand') the codex has. ὀλι-
γοχρόνιοι ('short-lived') instead of ὀλιγοχρονιώτεροι ('more short-lived') the epitomator always wrote. 6 ἔλαττον ('less') the codex has.
8-9 τῆς ἐνεργείας ('of the activity') conjectured by Kroll. 11 μεσετάτην ('most middle'). 19-20 καὶ ('and') - ἢ ςʹ ('or 6') is missing in the other
recension. “Mercury stays in individual signs for 28 days, the Sun for 30, and a cer-
tain part of the remaining five or six days of the year (namely 12 × 30 = 360
+ 5 or 6 = 365 or 366).” Boll. 20 τῶν ('of the') corrected by Boll. : τῆς ('of the') the codex has. 29 αὐξάνουσα ('increasing') the codex has.
φθίνουσα ('decreasing') the codex has. 30 ἔχων ('having') the codex has. τοιαύτητος ('of suchness') instead of ταυτότητος ('of sameness') the epitoma-
tor seems to have written. 31 The title is omitted by V(aticanus); cf. the preface. 33 γέννησεις ('births') N(eapoli-
tanus).

summary.headline: Planetary Rulers of the Millennia
summary.text: Discussion of the seven planetary rulers of successive millennia, linking each planet’s orbital zone and period to declining human longevity and, under the Moon, instability and deceit. The text then introduces the exact philosophy of the Chaldeans and astrological nativities.
